rules: A generic component must be told its type: <MudTextField T="string">.
Colours and type come through the components' own parameters: Color="Color.<value>", Typo="Typo.h6".

Type is the Typo you choose: never font-weight, font-size, line-height or letter-spacing in a Style attribute or in {name}.razor.css, not even unitless (font-weight: 600 is hard-coded too). When no Typo matches the design exactly, take the nearest one by size and weight.

The instance list gives each component's props by value: Color "Info" is written Color="Color.Info". Set the colour it gives, not Primary out of habit: Primary is only this theme's own default, which may not be the design's colour, and the pixel check compares the colours drawn.

Spacing and layout come from MudBlazor: MudStack (Spacing), MudGrid and its utility classes (pa-4, mt-2, gap-4, d-flex, justify-space-between, align-center), which step by 4 px. Use them in Class="…" rather than padding or margin in the stylesheet.

MudBlazor draws buttons and some labels in capitals by default (MudButton is text-transform: uppercase). The design's text must show exactly as designed: when it is not capitals, keep the case with Style="text-transform: none" on that component.

MudCheckBox and the other selection controls fill the width of their parent unless told otherwise: put one in a MudStack Row="true" or give it Class="d-inline-flex" when the design's control is only as wide as its label.
